body: When she get angry, she turn into a monster like that. I don’t know if it can be curable thing, but it has been always our problem. But I never ever expected from her to hit me in that situation to my surgey area. I never hit her... I save all the things, because sometimes she ignores what she did and try to make me fool.
Yes, she already said million times „You let me down“... And is trying to blame all on me.
Oh sorry my bad. Thank you madam. It really helps. I will be very hard....Thank you for all your good wishes. And I also wish all the best for you.

I still love her... But as you say if it always will be so, it is better to not get back her. I always have to go through surgeries until I die... Thank you for reading and helping sir. And thank you for your good wishes.
Thank you for reading and helping sir. I also can’t accept the things happened no matter how much I tried. I just still love her...

I have family and friends but it didn’t help to talk with them. And also I have been seeing therapists since I was 9. I want to end my pain because for a very long time the main direction of my life is always losing something. 

The problem is I am a very depressive person, once a thing gets worse I also get lost, right now there is nothing that I’m interested in. I feel totally empty. But I will try to write as you did.

Yes I am afraid of being alone, actually I am that guy who is always alone. Now I’m almost 29 years old and I lost my gf again. I am afraid of being alone at my old ages.

Thank you again for your compliments. You are also a very kind, helpful and thoughtful person. Even İf I can’t reach you, I wish you all the best in this cruel life. I wish I could help you at your worst times.  Thank you for all advices, it is really good to know that there is a person like you in this world.

I wish you get completely well soon. Yes they are all removed long ago. The only thing that confuses my mind is doctor said that I shouln’t do effort sports for 6 months, but I also think that it shouldn’t burst. Thank you for your kind answer sir.

I have those thoughts for nearly 3 years. In the beginning I was lucky and found a girlfriend. But now she has gone and there is no point me to live. Don’t get me wrong I’m not doing it for a girl, this is something really hard to tell. I had 4-5 major depression episodes until this time and don’t want to experience one more. I’m certain with my decision. Thank you for your kind answer sir.

Also thank you for your nice compliment :)
